C-ACCEPTANCE-REGISTRY.Name: Acceptance registry: one durable, ordered record of test artifacts, review waves and owner verdicts per delivery item
C-ACCEPTANCE-REGISTRY.Summary: Delivery items currently scatter their acceptance trail across train prose, PR threads, bundle ReviewLogs and chat, and isolated Mark Test artifacts live only in wipeable build directories with their build procedure re-derived by archaeology each time. This change standardizes acceptance into a machine-checked registry: every test artifact is registered (source sha, isolated bundle identity, binary digest, build recipe), every review wave is recorded (pass, verdict, findings disposition), and every owner verdict is written with its exact accepted scenarios or its rejection reason and rework destination — cross-validated against the collecting train so no item can sit in an ambiguous "probably accepted" state.
C-ACCEPTANCE-REGISTRY.ApprovalBasis: Owner request, 2026-10-21, after the acceptance-artifact gap was surfaced on PRs #17/#19: «это как-то хочется структурировать, стандартизировать тоже чтобы это было упорядочено как-то все, мы потом не запутались что где куда когда приняли не приняли почему отдали на переделку» — standardize acceptance bookkeeping so the team can always answer what was accepted, when, on which artifact, and why anything was sent back. Extends the existing acceptance-train protocol (docs/release-trains/README.md, "Record acceptance immediately") without replacing it: the train remains the admission authority; the registry is the ordered evidence trail feeding it.
C-ACCEPTANCE-REGISTRY.ProblemEvidence: 2026-10-21 session: the FIX-009 artifact had to be offered only after the owner asked "а что с приемкой пользователя?"; the Mark Test build procedure (merge-config identity substitution, no updater artifacts) existed only in expired-session memory and was recovered by git archaeology; the two clean reviews and the local-model review of #17/#19 live in this chat and partially in bundle ReviewLogs, while the owner's original CHANGES_REQUESTED reasons live in a /tmp report file; FIX-014's acceptance is currently blocked on an offline polygon with the alternatives recorded only in conversation. Previous artifacts (bcaebe05, bae95a97, 35fc0895, a0a524fd) are identifiable only by reading train prose.

Goals.Goal: A machine-readable registry at docs/acceptance/registry.json holding one record per test artifact (id, source commit/branch, platform, isolated bundle identity, binary SHA-256, builtAt, covers item ids, location, status) and one review/verdict trail per delivery item (state lifecycle with dated, attributed transitions: reported → repaired → reviewed → artifact-offered → owner-verdict → queued | rework, each verdict carrying exact scenarios or a rejection reason).

A human survey ledger at docs/acceptance/README.md: the protocol (lifecycle table, artifact requirements, verdict-recording rules mirroring the train README) plus one glance table of every tracked item's current state.

A validator (tools/acceptance-registry.mjs) wired into the vitest suite so CI enforces: schema integrity; every "repaired; acceptance pending" train item either has an offered artifact or an explicit not-applicable/blocked reason; every owner-accepted registry item matches its train admission; no artifact references a sha that does not exist in git.

A repeatable artifact builder (tools/build-test-artifact.mjs) that reproduces the isolated Mark Test procedure (merge-config identity, updater artifacts off, binary digest, smoke, registry append) so acceptance artifacts stop depending on session memory.

Backfill of the current 2.6.x-next wave only (FIX-009..016, follow-redirects, including tonight's review waves and the pending FIX-009 checklist offer); historical acceptance stays in the Released 2.5.x-next record and is explicitly out of scope.

Constraints.Constraint: The registry never replaces the train: admission stays in docs/release-trains/*.json|md; the registry feeds it and must stay consistent with it (the validator enforces both directions).
No workflow edits: the check rides the standard vitest matrix (tests/renderer/acceptance-registry.test.js), not a new CI job.
The builder must not touch tracked files: identity substitution happens through a temporary merge config only.
Registry state names and the lifecycle must mirror the train README's stage table so the two documents read as one protocol.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No backfill of pre-2.6.0 acceptance history (it is frozen prose in the Released train record).
No change to the owner's role: verdicts are recorded, never inferred; a missing verdict is an explicit pending state, never an implied acceptance.
No release automation change (tag/publication flows untouched).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tests/renderer/acceptance-registry.test.js passes: schema valid, git shas resolvable, cross-checks against 2.6.x-next.json hold in both directions (pending items have offers or documented blockers; accepted registry entries match train admissions).

The current wave is fully represented: FIX-010/012/015/016 recorded as accepted via the owner PR-16 review and queued; follow-redirects accepted and merged; FIX-013 recorded not-applicable-artifact (tooling) with its evidence link; FIX-014 recorded blocked-on-polygon with the offline status and both owner options; FIX-009 recorded artifact-offered with the Mark Test FIX009 checklist awaiting the owner's per-item verdict.
tools/build-test-artifact.mjs --help documents the procedure and a dry run prints the config it would merge without building.
grace lint --assertions current: zero errors; graph and verification deltas recorded.

AffectedAreas.Area: docs/acceptance/registry.json (new authority); docs/acceptance/README.md (new protocol + survey); tools/acceptance-registry.mjs (validator + helpers, new); tools/build-test-artifact.mjs (new); tests/renderer/acceptance-registry.test.js (new); docs/release-trains/README.md (one link in the Acceptance stage row); .grace/graph/features.xml M-046 SummaryDelta; .grace/verification/features.xml V-M-046 scenario; .grace/changes/active/C-ACCEPTANCE-REGISTRY/**.
